items.title: Lenovo G50-80 no power, +5VALW shorted
items.body: My Lenovo G50-80 has no power. I measured +5VALW and it is 0V. The VIN is 19V. I measured resistance to ground on +5VALW and got 8 ohms. Could a capacitor be shorted? The +3VALW is fine at 3.3V.

items.title: What is the difference between a buck and boost converter?
items.body: A buck converter steps voltage down; a boost converter steps it up. The buck uses a high-side MOSFET and a low-side diode (or synchronous MOSFET). The boost uses a low-side switch and a diode. Both use an inductor and a capacitor for energy storage and filtering.
